hypothesis: v11 seed instability motivates averaging all three models and testing a single preregistered disagreement penalty. Combine unconditional net payoff, not conditional-payoff means or logits. No seed picking, refitting, sizing, threshold sweep or data split change.
decision: Require at least6of8 folds jointly positive under normal/fee/execution scenarios, every scenarioDD<=20%, at least30fills. Disagreement is a heuristic, not a statistical confidence interval. Both results retained, further evidence required before deployment.
